fichas.title: Fishmonger
fichas.summary: Fresh fish is stored cool and smoked fish dry. Because goods are odour-intensive, access is controlled with doors or protective curtains. The design should allow for bulk deliveries; an aquarium may serve as display advertising.
uses: Retail sale of fresh and smoked fish
furniture_equipment: Fish display case with cooler and extraction

fichas.title: Game and Poultry Dealer
fichas.summary: A game and poultry business is often combined with a fishmonger. It stores only a day’s needs and requires a workroom with a plucking machine and game scraper. Poultry must be stored separately in the shop and cold room because it is susceptible to odour. Worktops and walls should be washable, with ample refrigerated display.
uses: Retail sale of game and poultry
furniture_equipment: Solid counter with marble and tiled worktop

fichas.title: Bakery
fichas.summary: The bakery traffic scheme connects delivery and staff areas with the bakery, storage, ovens, fermentation room, apparatus, café and shop. Storerooms should be well ventilated, possibly with vapour extraction.

fichas.title: Greengrocer
fichas.summary: Fresh vegetables, whether unprocessed or kitchen-ready, should be stored cool but not chilled. Potatoes are kept in dark rooms and sold from their deposit-bearing delivery containers. Protective sliding inserts go under storage trays. The shop may be combined with a flower shop; self-service shops offer pre-packed goods in transparent packs.
uses: Retail sale of fresh vegetables and fruit
Storage of potatoes in dark rooms
Optional combination with a flower shop
furniture_equipment: Protective sliding inserts under storage trays
Counter with mounting for boxes and wire baskets

fichas.title: Butcher
fichas.summary: The work sequence runs from delivery of live animals through slaughter, butchering, processing, cooling and storage, to sale. A single-storey shop is advantageous and may use hanging and sliding rails because sides of pork or quarters of beef are heavy. Processing and cold rooms should be 1.5–2 times the shop size. Walls and counter tops should be washable.
